what: Moving the mouse over a big title squashes the letter nearest the cursor in .12s (power2.out) to .7× vertical and .85× horizontal, tilting it away from the cursor, while neighbors on the same line squash by half. Then a damped spring (first overshoot is 1/3 of the squash, half period .16s) wobbles it back to normal over .8s. On overshoot the width stretches as if preserving volume. Each time the cursor moves to another letter it is pressed anew, giving a jelly-like line of letters.

options.squash: Share by which the width shrinks less (width shrinks by duck − squash), default .15

from.where: index.html all h1 and h2 (.pp-h) — original titlePop: duck .3 · squash .15 · lean .9 · near .5 · peak .1 · down .12 power2.out · spring rise .16 rest .8

note: Runs only on mouse. Text splits on hover, and once fully spread only the wrapping span is removed and the text returns to plain text. The line splitting of the same title (SplitText lines) stays. It waits while the title is entering (moving · transparent)
